name: Girandole
description: A centre boss with four drops hung around it.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 50% 50%, #000 18%, transparent 18%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 50% 12%, #000 9%, transparent 9%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 88% 50%, #000 9%, transparent 9%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 50% 88%, #000 9%, transparent 9%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 12% 50%, #000 9%, transparent 9%); mask: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 50% 50%, #000 18%, transparent 18%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 50% 12%, #000 9%, transparent 9%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 88% 50%, #000 9%, transparent 9%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 50% 88%, #000 9%, transparent 9%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 12% 50%, #000 9%, transparent 9%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
